ukmt-tmc-2025-national-crossnumber-01.prompt:
Complete the crossnumber. Each answer is a whole number whose digits fill the squares of the grid (the number in brackets is the number of digits); no answer starts with 0. Some clues refer to other answers.

**Across**

1. The sum of $\frac32$ of 7 Down and $\frac12$ of (15 Down + 14 Down) (4)
4. Prime factor of 12 Down (2)
6. The size, in degrees, of the interior angle of a regular polygon with $\frac{23\text{ Down}-1}{4}$ sides (3)
8. Fibonacci number that is also a multiple of 5 (4)
9. A cube (3)
10. The length of the shortest side of a right-angled triangle whose other sides are (16 Down $+18$) and (16 Down $+20$) (2)
11. The mean of 20 Down and 11 Across (3)
13. $\sqrt{98596}$ (3)
17. The fourth angle in a quadrilateral whose other angles are 16 Down, 6 Down and 23 Down (2)
18. A triangular number (3)
19. Fibonacci number that precedes 12 Down (4)
21. A multiple of 9 (3)
24. The sum of the digits of the sixth column of this crossnumber (2)
25. A palindromic number (4)

**Down**

1. The fourth angle in a quadrilateral whose other angles are 9 Across, 21 Across and 10 Across (2)
2. One less than a triangular number (3)
3. The value of $\sqrt{4\times6\text{ Across}}$ (2)
5. Ten less than the sum of 11 Across, 21 Across and $(2\times(17\text{ Across}+1))^2$ (4)
6. The size, in degrees, of the interior angle of a regular polygon with $\frac{21\text{ Across}}{9}$ sides (3)
7. Fibonacci number that precedes 8 Across (4)
8. A multiple of 9 (3)
12. Fibonacci number that is also a multiple of 37 (4)
14. A palindromic number (3)
15. The value of $x^3$ where $x$ is the two-digit factor of 25 Across (4)
16. The mean of 9 Across and 16 Down (3)
20. A square (3)
22. The length of the shortest side of a right-angled triangle whose other sides are (21 Across $-10$) and (21 Across $-15$) (2)
23. Highest prime factor of 8 Across (2)
